name: typeSfx
meaning: PROPERTY_SFXCINEMANAGER_TYPESFX (prop 0x24) truncated to a byte. 1 = drifting particles (SFXCINE_TYPE_SMOKE), 2 = fading flat billboards (SFXCINE_TYPE_RIPPLES), 4 = rising particles with a height cap (SFXCINE_TYPE_BUBBLES). Any other value updates and renders nothing.

name: spawnPending
meaning: 1 = emit one particle on this Update. Raised when the spawn timer wraps, passed as the spawn argument to the three Emitter_Update helpers, and cleared at 0x4f0d14 when one reports it consumed the request. NOTE the guard reads [ebp-4], which is uninitialised for an unknown typeSfx.

name: spawnTimer
meaning: Countdown to the next particle, decremented by g_dtMs 0x71b2e8 (1000 per second) and reloaded from spawnPeriod when it goes negative.

name: spawnPeriod
meaning: (LIFETIME << 12) / NBSFX, computed at 0x4f0ae2 with the RAW NBSFX ([ebp-0x10]) rather than the copy clamped to 32 - an unguarded divide if a level leaves NBSFX at 0. Units do not match spawnTimer: the period is 12.12 seconds but the timer counts milliseconds, so the real interval is 4.096x longer.

name: targetOffset
meaning: POSX/POSY/POSZ (props 0x10/0x14/0x18) truncated to s16 each; added to the target object's position to give the spawn point, ignored when there is no target.

name: emitter
meaning: The inline emitter (0x24-byte header, so 0x58..0x7b); its slot and particle buffers are allocated by Emitter_Init from min(NBSFX, 32). Render bails out unless emitter.flags bit 0 (this+0x7a = emitter+0x22) is set.

name: fadeParams
meaning: Parameters for typeSfx 2: life = LIFETIME<<12, fadeStart 0, spawnInterval 0x400, sizeStart = SIZE, sizeEnd = FINALSIZE, sheetIndex 1. The six stores land exactly on EmitterFadeParams.csv's offsets 0/4/8/0xc/0xe/0x10.

name: driftParams
meaning: Parameters for typeSfx 1: hSpeed = (s16)MOVESPEED, vSpeed -60 (upward), life = LIFETIME<<12, spawnInterval = life/16 (a signed divide, not a raw shift), sizeStart = SIZE, sizeEnd = FINALSIZE, sheetIndex 0.

name: riseParams
meaning: Parameters for typeSfx 4: riseSpeed -120 (upward), life = LIFETIME<<12, spawnInterval 0x400, size = SIZE, cap 0, sheetIndex 2.

name: target
meaning: PROPERTY_SFXCINEMANAGER_TARGET (prop 0x20) via Scn_GetPropObject. When set, particles spawn at target->pos + targetOffset and the drift angle comes from target->rot.facing (+0x16); when NULL the manager's own pos and facing are used. 0xd4+4 = 0xd8 = obj_size.
